spans.s: The third letter of the Devanāgarī alphabet.

P. (In Dhātup. written as इण्) (एति, इयाय, अगात्, एतुम्, इत) 
__1 To go, go to or towards, come to or near; शशिनं पुनरेति शर्वरी [[

.]] 
__2 To arrive at, reach, obtain, attain to, go to or be reduced to a particular state, fall into; निर्बुद्धिः क्षयमेति [[

]] goes to (ruin, is ruined; so वशम्, शत्रुत्बम्, शूद्रताम् &c.). 
__3 To return. 
__4 To go away, retire; elapse, pass. 
__5 To spring from, come or arise from. 
__6 To undertake anything (with acc.); सत्रमायन् [[Vāj.]] 
__7 To ask, beg. 
__8 To be; to appear. 
__9 To be employed in, go on with, be in a particular condition or relation, with a part. or instr.; कृषन्तो ह स्म बै बपन्तो यन्ति [[Śat. Br.]]; गबामयनेनेयुः [[Kāty.]] 
__10 To thrive, prosper.

Ā. 
__1 To come, appear. 
__2 To run, wander. 
__3 To go quickly or repeatedly. 
__4 To ask, request. -Caus. To cause to go or come. [cf. L. eo; Gr. eimi with एमि].

P. 
__1 To go. 
__2 To shine. 
__3 To pervade. 
__4 To desire, wish. 
__5 To throw. 
__6 To eat. 
__7 To beg (Ā). 
__8 To become pregnant.
